# Laksh Advani

> Staff Applied Scientist at ServiceNow in Seattle. 8+ years in ML. Works on RL post-training (RLVR, GRPO, process reward models), LLM agent reliability and recovery, evaluation, and safety.

## Experience
- ServiceNow, Staff Applied Scientist (2024–present)
- Qualtrics, Applied Scientist 2 (2021–2024)
- Capital One Labs, Applied Scientist (2019–2021)
- Sandia National Labs, Graduate Research Associate (2018–2019)
- M.S. Computer Science (ML/AI), University of Colorado Boulder

## Skills
- Post-training: RLVR, GRPO, KTO, DPO, PPO, Process reward models, RLAIF, Synthetic data, LoRA/QLoRA
- Agents and evals: Multi-agent orchestration, Tool-use RL environments, Context engineering, RAG, LLM-as-a-judge, Eval harness design, MCP, LangGraph
- Infrastructure: PyTorch, TorchTitan, DeepSpeed, Distillation, Quantization, vLLM, Kubernetes, Argo, AWS

- When Small Models Are Right for Wrong Reasons: Process Verification for Trustworthy Agents — AAAI 2026 Workshop on Trusted Agents (4 citations)
- Reading the Plan: Multi-Horizon Action Prediction from Frozen LLM Hidden States — NeurIPS 2026 Workshops — accepted at 5 of 5 workshops
